# Accepted decomposition basis

The owner accepted SCA-20261101-UNDERTAKING-EVALUATION on <GROUP3_ACCEPTANCE_DATE>
against exact candidate `<GROUP3_REVIEWED_COMMIT>` and the conditional changes in
[the amendment review](../_ScopeChange/SCA-20261101-UNDERTAKING-EVALUATION/GROUP3_REVIEW.md).

Recover the exact reviewed decomposition locally from this repository:

```sh
git show <GROUP3_REVIEWED_COMMIT>:execution/_Decomposition/PROJECT_DECOMP.md
```

The [working decomposition](PROJECT_DECOMP.md) differs from that reviewed content
only by the expressly accepted standing annotations. The [Group 2 plan](../_ScopeChange/SCA-20261101-UNDERTAKING-EVALUATION/GROUP2_PLAN.md)
and [Group 3 corrections](../_ScopeChange/SCA-20261101-UNDERTAKING-EVALUATION/GROUP3_CORRECTIONS.md)
identify the propagation and conditional writes. No remote publication is implied
or needed for this local recovery route; retain the named Git objects.

The [preceding formation payload](checkpoint_snapshots/GROUP3-20261101T011431Z/PROJECT_DECOMP.md),
[decision](checkpoint_snapshots/GROUP3-20261101T011431Z/DECISION.md),
[manifest](checkpoint_snapshots/GROUP3-20261101T011431Z/ACCEPTED_MANIFEST.csv)
and [audit](checkpoint_snapshots/GROUP3-20261101T011431Z/GROUP3_AUDIT.md)
remain unchanged. Their original seven-locality formation is historical.

The accepted addition requires current setup and scope/need authoring; the new
capability is not implemented or accepted as a product by this amendment.
Library release and consumer adoption remain separate decisions.
